title: Coverage recovery Wave 03 thin-history batch 1
notes: Fresh-main one-event depth batch from 423ae26af6b5ec75c1d0b3165377de549590efd2. Adds a second dated first-party lifecycle record to five current one-event entities. No product launch dates are inferred.

events.title: Atomic Wallet documented its 2025 perpetual futures launch
events.description: Atomic Wallet's 2025 year-in-review, published 2026-01-20, states that perpetual futures trading launched in November 2025 across its self-custodial wallet experience. The publication date is used as discovery chronology because the source does not provide an exact November launch day.

events.title: CoolWallet added multi-wallet management
events.description: CoolWallet announced on 2025-07-15 that its new Multi-Wallet Management feature was live, allowing users to manage multiple CoolWallet cold wallets and one hot wallet in the CoolWallet App and introducing a refreshed CoolWallet Pro and S setup experience.

events.title: D'CENT added scam-address detection safeguards
events.description: D'CENT announced on 2026-08-10 that its wallet added checks for known spam and phishing addresses, visible risk labels for suspicious transactions, in-app blocking/reporting, XRP tag reminders, and related send-flow safeguards.

events.title: Edge Wallet launched direct Revolut integration
events.description: Edge announced on 2025-09-02 that the wallet added a direct Revolut integration for buying crypto into the self-custody wallet and selling crypto back to a user's Revolut account without an additional intermediary account.

events.title: Bitcoin.com Wallet push notification incident occurred
events.description: Bitcoin.com reported that on 2026-03-06 a test push notification was inadvertently sent to iOS and Android Wallet users because of a third-party misconfiguration. Bitcoin.com stated the issue was resolved and did not involve user funds, wallet access, private keys, or wallet-infrastructure compromise.
